name: Global College Malta
summary: Private college at SmartCity Malta, licensed by the MFHEA, with seven English-taught three-year bachelor's in business, tourism and IT.

ib.text: Entry is worded as Maltese Matriculation "or equivalent": two Advanced, three Intermediate, Systems of Knowledge and English; or three Advanced levels. The IB is not named; ask GCM. IELTS 5.5 or similar English proof.

programmes.name: BA in Management
programmes.about: Three-year business degree (180 ECTS) covering business and management building blocks plus marketing, accounting and finance, data analysis, economics and entrepreneurship, through problem-based learning.
programmes.selectionNote: Personal statement, a reference letter and a video interview on spoken English, plus your school results. Places are offered as applications are reviewed.

programmes.selectionNote: Personal statement, a reference letter and a video interview on spoken English, plus your school results. Places are offered as applications are reviewed.

programmes.about: Tourism, events and the wider environment: how to evaluate and manage tourism and stage events in host destinations (180 ECTS).

programmes.name: BA in Accounting and Finance
programmes.about: Accounting and finance theory and practice, taught by practising professionals, to improve decision-making on real-world issues (180 ECTS); the page says it is eligible for the Get Qualified scheme.
programmes.selectionNote: Personal statement, a reference letter and a video interview on spoken English, plus your school results. Places are offered as applications are reviewed.

programmes.name: BA Information Technology for Business
programmes.about: How organisations collect, process, store and use digital information, alongside business, marketing, accounting, data analysis and entrepreneurship (180 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Personal statement, a reference letter and a video interview on spoken English, plus your school results. Places are offered as applications are reviewed.

notes: GCM runs five intakes a year (January, April, July, September and December 2027); September 2027 starts on 27 September and applications for it close on 11 June 2027.

The course pages name Global College Malta as awarding body (MFHEA-licensed, MQF Level 6); no partner university is named. The Top Up Degree in Business and Management is left out because it is not a first-year entry.
The course pages list the audience as 19–65+ and ask for a personal statement and a video interview; EU students pay €4,500 a year, international students €6,100 (Tourism €7,500).
